Meet the A4I- Microsoft Team


With expertise in creating Digital Public Goods, research, and program governance, the A4I team is dedicated to scaling platforms for greater societal impact. Powered by world-class research, technical excellence, and a shared commitment to social impact, the Microsoft team forms the backbone of impactful innovation at A4I.


(Names are listed alphabetically)

Microsoft Team

  • Aditi Bansal |

    Microsoft

  • Ishpreet Kaur |

    Microsoft

  • Manju Dhasmana |

    Lead – Philanthropies and CSR, Microsoft

    Leadership experience of 19+ years in Civic and Societal Impact – Recipient of 100 Most Impactful CSR Leaders Award – across Development, Diversity, Gender, Outreach and Policy Advocacy with robust entrepreneurial expertise in social entrepreneurship development, project planning and implementation, last mile connectivity, governmental liaising and developing talent capabilities aligned to business goals.

  • Manohar Swaminathan |

    Principal Researcher, Microsoft Research

  • Mohit Jain |

    Principal Researcher, Microsoft Research

  • Tanuja Ganu |

    Director of Research Engineering, Microsoft Research

IIITB Team

  • Aanchal |

    Research Associate

    Anchal is a Research Associate at the Microsoft AI Innovation and Inclusion Initiative (A4I) at IIIT Bangalore. She has a Master’s degree in Information Technology from IIIT Bangalore and a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from IIITDM Kancheepuram. Her research interests include HCI, Accessibility, and ICT4D. She has been working on accessibility in digital health.

  •  Alex Philip |

    AI Infrastructure Engineer at A4I

    Alex is a seasoned Multi-cloud AI Infra DevOps Engineer, boasting nearly 4 years of experience optimizing automation for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines. Known for his exceptional communication and collaboration skills, Also excels at uniting development and operations teams.

  • Amit Prakash |

    Professor & HoD, Digital Humanities, IIIT Bangalore

    Amit Prakash is a Professor at IIIT Bangalore and Head of the Department of Digital Humanities. He helped set up CITAPP, CAGS, and EHRC at IIITB. His research is in information systems, governance, and public policy—especially for health, education, and livelihoods. Formerly with Deloitte, PwC, and C-DAC.

  • Ananya Mishra |

    Digital Marketing and Content Specialist

    With over five years of experience as a marketing professional, Ananya specializes in branding, communication, SEO, social media and content marketing as a whole.

  • Ashish Srivastava  |

    Chief Impact Officer at A4I  

    Ashish is Chief Impact Officer at A4I (AI Innovation for Inclusion Initiative)—an IIITB and Microsoft Research collaboration. Formerly with Wipro, Tata Steel, IISc Innovation Hub, and SLK V-Labs (AI). He’s led large-scale public health, AI, and digital projects and serves on advisory boards.

  • Ashok Maddhuru |

    AI Engineer

    Ashok is an AI Engineer at A4I Lab, IIIT Bangalore, specializing in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI. Formerly, he contributed to AI projects for global technology and hospitality companies, including AMD, Hilton, and Marriott.

  • Farman Ahmed |

    Software Developer

    Farman has worked on engineering projects with A4I Labs at the International Institute of Information and Technology Bangalore (IIITB), focusing on backend systems and scalable service integration.

  • JD Santhosh  |

    Research Assistant at A4I

    JD is a research assistant at A4I

  • Mohammed Muqsit |

    A4I

  • Nikunj Khakhkhar |

    Frontend Development

    Nikunj is part of the development team

  • Oindrila Matilal |

    Post- doctoral researcher

    Oindrila completed her PhD at IIIT Bangalore (IIITB) and subsequently worked as a Research Associate at IIITB on a Centre for Effective Global Action (CEGA), University of California, Berkeley-funded project on data privacy in digital credit. She has taught courses on AI and Society, Contemporary Social Problems and Quantitative Research Methods at Christ University, Bangalore, and is a UGC-NET (JRF) qualified sociologist.

  • Pradyumna Taduri |

    A4I Project Coordinator

    Pradyumna is a manager/researcher at A4I (CAGS). Previously research associate on Fairwork India (CITAPP, IIITB). Interests: technology in ICTD, labor, and accessibility.

  • Punit Kaushik |

    Software Developer at A4I

    Punit Kaushik has worked on engineering projects at A4I, focusing on AI systems, agentic AI, and software development. His work includes designing and developing intelligent AI systems, architecting agent-based workflows, and building scalable software solutions for real-world applications.

  • Shubha Krishnamurthy |

    Post-doctoral fellow at A4I

    Shubha is an Information Systems researcher, previously two decades in product/dev management. PhD from IIMB (“Navigating the Evolving Telemedicine Landscape”), MS from BITS Pilani.

  • Shyam Sunder Kumar |

    AI Lead Engineer

    Applied AI Engineer building AI-first products, focused on LLMs, agents, and real-world automation.

  • Sneha Singh |

    Research Associate at A4I

    Sneha holds a postgraduate diploma in Digital Product Design and Management from IIIT Bangalore and a bachelor’s in design in Knitwear Design from NIFT Chennai. Her research interests lie in inclusive technology, user-centered design, and the social dimensions of digital access. She aims to use design research to shape equitable, context-aware digital solutions for underserved communities.

  • Sookthi Kav |

    Research Associate at A4I

    Sookthi is a Research Associate at the A4I Team centred at CAGS. She is a graduate of the M.Sc. Digital Society programme at IIITB. In the past, she has worked with large-scale educational assessments and EdTech for social good. Her interests lie in shifting tech practice towards inclusion and social justice, and she hopes to contribute to building a just world with fewer violent algorithmic black boxes.

  • Soumabha Ray Chaudhuri |

    Chief Architect at A4I

    Soumabha is a technology enthusiast and experienced leader. Formerly with Everwell Health, Samsung Research and Quikr, he has built engineering teams, scaled application ecosystems across international boundaries and leveraged AI for cross functional growth.
